title: Handle payment_failed webhook events
description: Adds dunning emails for `invoice.payment_failed`. Also hardens the webhook: the provider retries on any non-2xx response, and a retry storm took the billing worker down last week.

expected_issues.description: Every handler failure is silently discarded and the endpoint still returns 200, so the provider never retries and nothing is logged: a failed `mark_invoice_paid` leaves a paid invoice marked unpaid with no trace. At minimum log the exception; better, return 5xx for transient failures and dedupe retries.
